concepts.scene: A single corded telephone receiver rests off its cradle on a plain wooden desk in a dim room, its cord trailing down into a small unlabelled black box on the floor, a lone desk lamp casting the only light, no papers or screens visible, walls bare and unbranded.
concepts.why: the reader wonders why a phone off the hook at 2am matters to a software business.

concepts.scene: On the left, an operator sits at a plain desk typing on a keyboard connected to a small blank terminal, three physical inboxes stacked behind them holding loose papers, buckets of fresh flowers visible at the edge of the frame, the operator's hand moving a single sheet from one tray into a neat, nearly empty final tray on the right side of the desk.
concepts.from_script: I automated about eighty percent of that PM busywork with a few AI workflows
concepts.why: viewers want to know what work at a florist could possibly be 80 percent erased.

concepts.scene: On the right, an operator leans over a small wall-mounted panel of blank, unlabelled cable ports, plugging one cord into an open slot while glancing at a plain analog clock on the wall, a second identical panel visible further down the same wall, both panels wired into a single thin conduit running along the baseboard.
concepts.from_script: Two solid retainer clients, reportedly seven to twelve thousand dollars a month combined, can cover a solo founder's income
concepts.why: the dollar figure paired with just two visible panels raises the question of how few clients it actually takes.

concepts.scene: Two operators stand in the same modest office, one adjusting a small server tower on a desk with a single blinking light, the other looking out a window at a distant, blurred large data center building on the horizon, both figures mid-motion, no readable markings on either structure.
concepts.from_script: it did it on about one and a half million dollars of venture money
concepts.why: the contrast between a desk-sized box and a distant data center makes the funding gap feel absurd.

concepts.scene: A wide view of a small office where dozens of thin unbranded cables run from a cluster of plain grey boxes scattered across desks and shelves, all converging toward a single small hub at the center of the room, one operator kneeling to connect a final cable while the rest of the tangle stretches out toward the edges of the frame.
concepts.from_script: a market analysts estimate at somewhere between fourteen and twenty-three billion dollars in 2026, growing north of twenty percent a year
concepts.why: the sheer density of converging cables makes the reader curious how large the underlying market really is.
